name: business-planning
description: Owner-led financial and strategic planning for startups and established companies, with optional internal counterpart contributions.

interface.shortDescription: Build owner-led strategic or financial plans.
interface.longDescription: Business Planning supports startups, new ventures and established companies through one adaptive workflow. The product initially invoked owns the user journey and final result. Vera prepares the financial plan and funding needs with linked P&L, cash flow, balance sheet, scenarios and reconciliation. Clara prepares the strategic and commercial business plan with evidence-linked findings, options, recommendations, initiatives, milestones, KPIs and risks. When the scope needs both lenses, the counterpart contributes internally to the same owner-led plan; the user does not transfer files or manage a second workflow.
defaultPrompt: Prepare the financial plan and funding needs for this company from reviewed evidence and confirmed assumptions.
Prepare the strategic and commercial business plan for this company from reviewed evidence and assumptions.
Prepare a complete plan; keep the invoked product as owner and include any counterpart contribution internally.
